english.title: Sex offender - false information to police subsequent to registration
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) notified to the police, in purported compliance with section 2(2) of the Sex Offenders Act 1997, information as to

(A)_[your name, namely **(..SPECIFY..),]_
(B)_[a change in your home address, namely **(..SPECIFY..),]_
(C)_[the address of the premises where you stayed or resided for more than 14 days, namely **(..SPECIFY..),]_
(D)_[your date of birth, namely **(..SPECIFY..),]_
(E)_[the name, namely **(..SPECIFY..), used by you on **(..SPECIFY RELEVANT DATE..),]_
(F)_[each of the names, namely **(..SPECIFY..), used by you on **(..SPECIFY RELEVANT DATE..),]_
(G)_[your home address, namely **(..SPECIFY..), on **(..SPECIFY RELEVANT DATE..),]_

which you knew to be false
english.legislation: Contrary to section 3(1)(b) and (1A) of the Sex Offenders Act 1997.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
THIS OFFENCE IS NOW OBSOLETE - Now see offence wording CJS Code SX03204 - H5862 or CJS Code SX03205 -H5863

(i) It is suggested that the six months time limit period for prosecution commences on the day the offence is discovered - NOT the day the offence starts.
(ii) The offence starts on the first day of failure to comply and continues throughout any period of failure.
(iii) Offender will only be prosecuted once for the same failure (section 3(2)).
(iv) As amended by Schedule 5 to the Criminal Justice and Court Services Act 2000.
(v) See Section 2(7) for meaning of "home address" and Section 1(8) for "relevant date"
(vi) Repealed by s.140 of and Schedule 7 to the Sexual Offences Act 2003

None
